title: Answer with code evidence (LPM Advisor)
description: Use when a project's code or roadmap question must be answered from the indexed repository (LPM Advisor): does the code do X, onde está Y, technical impact, roadmap analysis, exact source lines. Read-only. Not for building or refreshing the index (use lpm-code-index).
doneWhen: Facts (cited path:line@commit), inferences and limitations are kept apart, and `codeEvidence.status` is stated.
authorityCeiling: Read-only. Searches and impact runs spend the daily code-search quota; Advisor answers spend the workspace AI budget.
jobs: o código já faz <X>? responda com evidência do código
where is <identifier> defined in the project's code?
what is the technical impact of roadmap item <ABC-12>?
analise o roadmap e diga quais itens ainda não têm código
show me the exact lines of <path> at the indexed commit

notFor.when: building, refreshing or activating a code index, or rescanning a repository
roadmap records or a roadmap change request
the AI budget, model or AI policy
saving an analysis as a knowledge note

sharedRefs.name: advisor-semantics
sharedRefs.loadWhen: background on Advisor fields and guards; the playbooks already hold its rules

references.loadWhen: playbook code-question: does one project's code do X, or where is Y in it
playbook workspace-code-question: where is Y in the code of any project of a workspace
playbook exact-lines: show the exact lines of a file at the indexed commit
playbook roadmap-analysis: analyze a whole roadmap, or which roadmap items have no code yet
playbook item-impact: analysis or technical impact of one roadmap item
playbook advisor: one LPM Advisor answer about a project, a roadmap item or a roadmap

codex.shortDescription: Answer LPM code and roadmap questions with cited evidence
codex.defaultPrompt: Use $lpm-ask-advisor to answer from the indexed code of LPM project <projectId>: <question>
